title: Addressing Exogenous Variability in Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.22067v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) often fails under exogenous variability such as shifts in opponents or environment regimes that cannot be controlled by the team but alter the transition dynamics. We formalize this challenge as Exogenous Dec-POMDP (ED-POMDP), in which an episode-level exogenous regime, selected independently of the team, indexes the dynamics, and the global state is partitioned into components that are directly responsive to the current team action and components that are not directly action-responsive at the current step. This formulation exposes mediated influence: while team actions do not directly update the latter at the current step, they can shape their later evolution through induced changes in the former. translated_title: 解决协作多智能体强化学习中的外生变异性问题
translated_abstract: 协作多智能体强化学习（MARL）在外生变异性下常常失效，例如对手变化或环境状态变化等团队无法控制但会改变转移动力学的因素。我们将这一挑战形式化为外生Dec-POMDP（ED-POMDP），其中回合级的外生状态（独立于团队选择）对动力学进行索引，且全局状态被划分为直接响应当前团队动作的组成部分与在当前步骤不直接响应动作的组成部分。这一形式化揭示了中介影响：虽然团队动作在当前步骤不会直接更新后者，但可以通过引发前者的变化来塑造后者的后续演化。基于此，我们提出了LEICA，一种与CTDE兼容的算法，它为这两个组成部分学习基于历史的上下文表示，并利用智能体级别的、影响……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了外生Dec-POMDP（ED-POMDP）形式化框架来刻画协作多智能体强化学习中的外生变异性与中介影响，并据此设计了CTDE兼容的LEICA算法，通过学习基于历史的上下文表示来改进策略更新。
en_tdlr: The paper formalizes exogenous variability in cooperative MARL as Exogenous Dec-POMDP (ED-POMDP), exposing mediated influence, and proposes LEICA, a CTDE-compatible algorithm that learns history-conditioned context representations to shape policy updates.
